risk_free_rate.method: 10-year nominal par Treasury yield; choose maturity consistently with USD DCF

msft_quote.status: intraday or delayed snapshot; not asserted to be closing price

us_equity_risk_premium.status: published Damodaran estimate, not a company fact; verify source vintage before valuation

cost_of_debt.status: select marginal borrowing rate using Treasury curve and credit spread; historical interest/debt is only a cross-check

terminal_growth.status: analyst assumption; must be less than WACC

wacc.status: calculate after choosing capital structure, beta, debt spread, ERP and normalized tax rate
